name: dsh-windows-toolbox
description: One Windows toolbox with two halves. The registration-point half indexes eleven places Windows lets software hook itself in — services, scheduled tasks, autostart (six sources), shell extensions, installed programs, AppX/MSIX, drivers, firewall rules, IFEO, file associations, credential providers — and can enable, disable or roll back five of them, with a plain-language explanation for every row. The maintenance half is 25 read-mostly capabilities: cleanup across nine groups, large and duplicate files, network diagnosis and repair, DNS switching, security and privacy posture, speed test, tweaks, shredder, driver and software catalogs. Everything runs locally; every write is a dry run first. · WINDOWS工具箱：一半是 Windows 插件化管理（十一类注册点索引 + 八项系统修复），一半是系统维护（25 项能力：清理、体检、修复、软件与驱动）。全部本地执行，写操作先预演。
